name: jenkins-qa-pipeline
description: API (Newman) and UI (Cypress) tests against public practice sites, run by a Jenkins pipeline.

scripts.test:api: newman run api-tests/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e api-tests/restful-booker.postman_environment.json -r cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/api/newman-junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api/index.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful-Booker API tests"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:ui
